about: Rail centre-line geometry and rolling stock placement test vectors for docs/RAIL-GEOMETRY.md. Generated by bench/railbench/gen-vectors.mjs from the reference model (bench/railbench/railgeom.mjs) and from carriages recorded in Factorio 2.1.19.
units: Map coordinates in tiles (x east, y south); directions are 16-way defines.direction values; orientations are Factorio orientations in turns (0 north, 0.25 east); s is the game's rail distance from the piece's front end.

tolerance.note: piece_points: an implementation of the spec's formulas against the reference model (the ramp's inverse length table may differ by up to 1e-4; use 1e-3 for rail-ramp). The game itself places joints with polynomial fits of the curves (within 0.01 tile of the formulas) on a 1/256 tile grid. The legacy curved rail ends 0.011 tile from its connection point (its last part is drawn with the arc formula).

trains.note: game orientations are the carriage's own facing (a carriage facing the train's rear is half a turn off the model's front-pointing orientation); compare them as axes
